entries.194e502e3788d129: This is the Group's core business, conducting freight trucking, rail freight forwarding, air freight forwarding, marine transportation, harbor transportation, warehousing and other businesses in regions in Japan and overseas. Five areas, “Japan,” “Americas,” “Europe,” “East Asia,” and “South Asia and Oceania,” are its reportable segments. The companies carrying out this business are Nippon Express Co., Ltd. and NX America Co., Ltd., along with 275 other companies. Revenue from external customers for the Group as a whole, by product and service (fiscal year ended December 2025), was ¥535,234 million for air transportation, ¥462,007 million for warehousing and distribution processing, ¥396,327 million for marine transportation, and ¥352,467 million for motor vehicle transportation.
entries.195c5cf6564d60de: This segment covers operations in cities across the Americas, in which subsidiaries and affiliates including NX America Co., Ltd. conduct air freight forwarding, marine transportation, warehousing and other businesses.

entries.3e7830c712d68e58: This is a specialized business in which NX Cash Logistics Co., Ltd. conducts security services and related businesses. The main businesses of the reportable segment are security services and trucking. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥68,597 million (¥67,851 million in the fiscal year ended December 2024), and revenue including intersegment internal revenue was ¥69.5 billion, a 1.4% increase from the prior-year period. Although there were fewer scheduled trips and a reactionary decline from the prior year's handling of revisions, the effect of rate revisions was positive. As of December 31, 2025, NX Cash Logistics Co., Ltd. was a consolidated subsidiary (voting rights ownership: 100.0%).
entries.3fb74bf3b0da5afa: This segment covers operations in cities across South Asia and Oceania, in which subsidiaries and affiliates including NX Singapore Co., Ltd., NX Australia Co., Ltd., NX Malaysia Co., Ltd., NX Thailand Co., Ltd. and NX Logistics Indonesia Co., Ltd. conduct air freight forwarding, marine transportation, warehousing, heavy equipment construction and other businesses.
entries.4f5cb6a861646e27: This segment covers operations in cities across the Americas, in which subsidiaries and affiliates including NX America Co., Ltd. conduct air freight forwarding, marine transportation, warehousing and other businesses. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥121,416 million (¥134,388 million in the fiscal year ended December 2024), and revenue including intersegment internal revenue was ¥138.0 billion, a 9.8% decrease from the prior-year period. Handling of air cargo and marine cargo declined. As of December 31, 2025, consolidated subsidiaries included NX America Co., Ltd. (Chicago, United States; voting rights ownership: 100.0%, all held indirectly).
entries.58a12142a3632b77: This segment covers operations in cities across South Asia and Oceania, in which subsidiaries and affiliates including NX Singapore Co., Ltd., NX Australia Co., Ltd., NX Malaysia Co., Ltd., NX Thailand Co., Ltd. and NX Logistics Indonesia Co., Ltd. conduct air freight forwarding, marine transportation, warehousing, heavy equipment construction and other businesses. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥129,006 million (¥138,752 million in the fiscal year ended December 2024), and revenue including intersegment internal revenue was ¥155.4 billion, a 1.4% decrease from the prior-year period. Handling of air cargo declined, and it was affected by a drop in selling unit prices. As of December 31, 2025, consolidated subsidiaries included NX South Asia and Oceania Co., Ltd. (Singapore; voting rights ownership: 100.0%).
entries.71385f4ffa0e47cf: This segment covers operations in cities across East Asia, in which subsidiaries and affiliates including NX International Logistics (China) Co., Ltd., NX Hong Kong Co., Ltd., APC Asia Pacific Cargo Co., Ltd., NX Korea Co., Ltd. and NX Taiwan International Logistics Co., Ltd. conduct air freight forwarding, marine transportation, warehousing and other businesses. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥147,561 million (¥161,585 million in the fiscal year ended December 2024), and revenue including intersegment internal revenue was ¥165.8 billion, a 4.7% decrease from the prior-year period. Although handling of air cargo increased, handling of marine cargo declined, mainly in apparel and household furniture-related goods. As of December 31, 2025, consolidated subsidiaries included NX International Logistics (China) Co., Ltd. (Beijing, People's Republic of China; voting rights ownership: 100.0%, all held indirectly).
entries.7ba99be85ecd6d89: This segment covers operations in cities across Europe, in which subsidiaries and affiliates including NX UK Co., Ltd., NX Netherlands Co., Ltd., NX France Co., Ltd., NX Italia Co., Ltd., Cargo Partners Holdings GmbH and Simon Hegele Holding GmbH conduct air freight forwarding, marine transportation, warehousing and other businesses. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥513,815 million (¥491,505 million in the fiscal year ended December 2024), and revenue including intersegment internal revenue was ¥527.9 billion, a 5.2% increase from the prior-year period. The increase in revenue was due to higher air cargo handling and the inclusion of Simon Hegele in the scope of consolidation for the first time. As of December 31, 2025, consolidated subsidiaries included NX Europe GmbH (Germany; voting rights ownership: 100.0%) and Cargo Partners Holdings GmbH (Austria; 100.0%, all held indirectly).

entries.8f4bb791c414363b: The holding company of a logistics group that has Nippon Express and others under its umbrella and handles air, sea, motor vehicle transport and warehousing in Japan and overseas, as well as security transport and heavy cargo construction.
entries.9228ba0f622f530e: This is a specialized business in which NX Engineering Co., Ltd. and its affiliates conduct transport, erection and installation of heavy objects and related businesses (NX Engineering Co., Ltd. and 2 other companies). Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥45,136 million (¥50,021 million in the fiscal year ended December 2024), and revenue including intersegment internal revenue was ¥48.5 billion, a 2.9% decrease from the prior-year period. Handling of shutdown maintenance work and similar increased, while handling of wind power construction-related work declined. As of December 31, 2025, NX Engineering Co., Ltd. was a consolidated subsidiary (voting rights ownership: 100.0%).

entries.a992feb2c9738a4c: This business involves NX Trading Co., Ltd. and 42 other domestic and overseas subsidiaries and affiliates, which sell various products such as logistics equipment, packaging materials, packing materials, vehicles, petroleum and LP gas, and which also provide vehicle maintenance, insurance agency services, real estate, logistics finance and other services. NX Sogo Kenkyusho Co., Ltd. conducts research and study services and other businesses, NX Capital Co., Ltd. conducts group finance and other businesses, and NX Career Road Co., Ltd. conducts worker dispatch business. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥326,937 million (¥305,020 million in the fiscal year ended December 2024), and revenue including intersegment internal revenue was ¥446.7 billion, a 6.2% increase from the prior-year period. Handling in the logistics products, vehicle maintenance and manufacturing, and real estate divisions increased. By product and service, revenue from external customers for the Group as a whole included ¥219,409 million from petroleum and other sales. As of December 31, 2025, the principal consolidated subsidiaries were NX Trading Co., Ltd., NX Capital Co., Ltd. and NX Career Road Co., Ltd. (all with voting rights ownership of 100.0%), and Osaka Soko Co., Ltd. (79.4%).
entries.b3528c581cc3fdd5: This segment covers operations in Japan, in which Nippon Express Co., Ltd., its subsidiaries and affiliates conduct rail freight forwarding, trucking, warehousing, air freight forwarding, marine transportation, harbor transportation and related businesses. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥1,222,355 million (¥1,228,517 million in the fiscal year ended December 2024), and revenue including intersegment internal revenue was ¥1,260.3 billion, a 0.1% decrease from the prior-year period. Although rate revisions had an effect, handling of various items, including air cargo and marine cargo, declined. As of December 31, 2025, the principal consolidated subsidiaries were Nippon Express Co., Ltd. (voting rights ownership: 100.0%), NX NP Logistics Co., Ltd. (66.7%) and Nittsu NEC Logistics Co., Ltd. (70.0%), and NX OneBishi Archives Co., Ltd. (100.0%, all held indirectly) and its subsidiaries conduct information asset management.
